integrity: All asserted infinite-parameter conclusions are derived analytically; computational tests are finite consistency checks. No independent validation or publication status is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem guarantees at least two Hessian sign changes but no exact transition count or thresholds.
Only local small- and large-area optimality of squares is proved; the global claim is nonsquare existence in the unstable regime.
The result concerns squared Hilbert-Schmidt norm for a balanced incoherent pair, not spectral norm, coherent superposition, or arbitrary convex domains.
Bibliographic precedence cannot be conclusively excluded by database and literature comparisons.
title: Reentrant aspect-ratio instability in two-window Gaussian localization
